caption: The drawing features a golden-brown rooster with detailed feather patterns on its body, wings, and tail. The rooster is positioned in profile facing to the right, with its beak open and a comb atop its head. The feathers are shaded with varying tones of brown and gold, giving a sense of texture and dimension. The rooster is mounted on top of a geometric base, which consists of a sphere and a tapered vertical support. The base is only partially illustrated in faint pencil lines, with no coloration, while the rooster itself is fully colored and detailed. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, providing contrast to the colored illustration of the rooster and the outlined base.
title: Weather Vane
